main.description: A named group of channels within a community.

items.description: The space key of a channel in this category.

channelOrder.description: The channels in this category, in display order, by space key.

ownerOnly.description: Whether only community admins may post in the category's channels. A channel that sets its own posting restriction overrides this.

allowedRoles.description: Roles allowed to post in the category's channels. Empty means no role restriction. A channel that sets its own posting restriction overrides this.

allowedMembers.description: Members allowed to post in the category's channels in addition to allowedRoles.

visibleToRoles.description: Roles that may read the category's channels. Empty or absent means every member may read them. A channel with its own non-empty visibleToRoles or visibleToMembers overrides this. A non-empty list makes the category's other channels private, enforced the same way as a private channel.

visibleToMembers.description: Members that may read the category's channels in addition to visibleToRoles.
